name: upstream-docs
description: A version-aware evidence gate for dependency, framework, and platform API claims.

interface.shortDescription: Know which version your AI is talking about.
interface.longDescription: Keep repository constraints, resolved versions, migration targets, stable releases, and prerelease evidence separate before accepting an upstream claim.
defaultPrompt: Verify this API claim for an exact target version.
Check whether this feature is stable in the current release.
Compare the repository version with this migration target.
